The release where a fund reads a report from a company that is not on the platform. Since v0.6.0 (November 1, 2026) the Reports page lists reports loaded from a file beside the ones a company shared, the SEC repository opens with a free trial that needs no card, and a public company keeps its page and its filings when it changes ticker or registrant. The series went out as nine patch releases; this file is the account of it as a whole.

## 📄 Reports from a file

- **The Reports page lists every report the fund received,** not only those shared from a company's own graph. A report loaded from a PDF or a spreadsheet the company sent shows an upload icon beside the company and the date it was loaded, and its page says which way it came (#438)
- **A holding's value total says when it covers only some positions.** Beside the total, "N of M marked" appears when some positions carry a mark and some do not. The total itself is unchanged (#439)

## 🔎 The SEC repository trial

- **The trial needs no card.** The browse and subscriptions screens carry the trial through its whole life: a running trial is badged "Free trial", a refused trial keeps its reason on the page with a link to resend the verification email, a plan change inside the trial says nothing is charged today, and a seat that ended at once is no longer listed as running (#429, #437)
- **The filing chat says when it opens.** On a company page, "Ask about this filing" is closed during a trial, with a line saying it opens with the plan and a link to where the plan starts. The trial covers the analysis tools; the chat opens with the first payment. A subscriber who cancelled an earlier trial and then paid sees the chat, not the trial notice (#440)
- **The getting-started page states the trial's limits:** the analysis tools over MCP and the API are open, and raw Cypher and the AI analyst open with the first payment (#437)

## 🏢 Public companies and research

- **A filer that changes ticker keeps its page.** `/research/{old}` redirects to the new ticker, and searching the old ticker still finds the company, ranked right after an exact match (#426, #427)
- **Each filing links to EDGAR under the registrant that filed it.** A company that changed registrant and kept its ticker lists its predecessor's filings, and those now link under the predecessor instead of the current registrant (#430)
- **A CDN failure keeps the last good page.** A research page, the research index, the sitemap, `llms.txt` and a docs page each keep their last good render through an outage instead of caching a 404 or an empty list for the hour (#419, #420)
- **The public pages say what RoboInvestor is today:** early, with shared reports read side by side with the public filings. Research pages carry the shared footer, and the landing copy names the card-free trial (#432, #436)

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- **Table headers are valid markup again** on Entities, Portfolio and Reports. The header cells had lost their row in the move to the owned UI layer (#425)

## 🔧 Infrastructure

- **`@robosystems/client` 2.35.0 → 2.42.0.** Operation streams are read over `fetch` with the credential in a header, in place of `EventSource` with a token in the URL; a stream that opens and ends no longer reconnects forever. **`@robosystems/core` 0.19.0 → 0.21.7,** carrying the trial screens and the docs catalog and renderer the app now reads from core. **`@robosystems/report-components` 0.13.0 → 0.13.2** (#419, #424, #429, #431, #435, #437, #439)
- **CI:** `setup-uv` moves to v10.3.3, pinned by SHA (#423)
- **For forks and self-hosters:** the development stack's S3 server and public bucket are on port 8333; `.env.example` carries the new `NEXT_PUBLIC_S3_ENDPOINT_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_FILINGS_CDN_URL` values (#428)

## 📦 Deploy notes

- **The API goes first.** The Reports page and the portfolio total read fields served from robosystems v1.23.13, and the trial screens follow the trial fields the API returns. Deploy this app after that API release is live.
- **No CloudFormation changes and no new variables or secrets.**
